notes.title: Update 2.1
notes.content: With update 2.1 you can now choose two characters with a single control in training mode ... incredible but it took us 6 years to add that. Sorry.

Thanks!

notes.title: Combate Monero 1.9 Update
notes.content:
Fatima and Tetsuko join the fight!

Two new fighters are coming to Combat Monero in this long overdue update.

Tetsuko Kiyama is a classic Japanese schoolgirl who is not only a fervent admirer and practitioner of martial arts, but also a powerful psychomancer who must fight to save the world.

notes.title: Two New Characters enter the roster... soon!
notes.content:
Two New characters enter the Ring! El Monito and Pepe

Pepe comes from the "Nahualo" WEBCOMIC by Daniel Garza Ledesma y Juan Manuel Colín Monroy, who publishes it on facebook.

He can morph into 4 animals or a super nahual mode!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34917749/6a26527a1a1d9604db66758bbe79f1fbedad1395.jpg

El Monito was created by Rubén Armenta and is the self proclaimed WORST comic book character in the world, still, he roams the multiverse looking for fame.
